capabilities: Publish and update notes as WordPress posts via the REST API
Upload local vault images to the media library and rewrite links
Set statuses, schedules, slugs, excerpts, categories, tags, and featured images
Manage multiple WordPress site profiles with per-site defaults
Detect remote edits and warn before overwriting published posts
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin listing; installable manually or via BRAT. Credentials are stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json, and WordPress.com hosts are not supported. Full Chinese and English UI.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to a self-hosted WordPress blog and keep each note linked to its post for updates.

requires.name: WordPress user with publish/upload capabilities and an Application Password

summary: Publishes Obsidian notes as WordPress posts with categories, tags, featured images, media uploads, scheduling, previews, and multi-site profiles.
